description: New red-team cases (evals/datasets/redteam_e2e.json) that the bot is known to fail, with the reason. A strict list: a failing new case that is not listed here fails the gate, and a listed case that starts passing is reported. Entries are removed by the PR that fixes them; nothing is ever added to hide a regression. Empty since the final run of the Phase 7 must-fix series (ADR 0027): the seven gaps of the baseline (ob03, ob13, ob14, sh02, sh03, sh06, sh08) passed every repeat.
